title: Davis meets Grusch at the Aerospace Corporation and hands over his data

tellings.quote: I worked for the AOS space Corporation and that's how I met Dave brush right Jay Stratton introduced me to Dave

plain: At the Aerospace Corporation, a research group that works for the US military's space programmes, in Colorado Springs, the physicist Eric W. Davis met David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who later spoke out publicly about UFOs, and passed him his data. Davis says this happened to him while he worked there, and that the introduction was made by Jay Stratton, a former Navy intelligence officer. It matters because it puts Davis's information behind Grusch's later claims.
